summary: This system embeds an LLM/AI surface (an LLM/AI integration); the risks below are architectural — they follow from how untrusted input reaches the model's prompt, tools, and outputs.

ai_risks.name: Excessive Agency
ai_risks.description: The LLM is granted tool/function-calling authority without a secondary authorization boundary, so a manipulated model turn can invoke privileged actions on the user's behalf.

findings.label: Chatbot coupon tool lacks server-side discount limit

ai_risks.name: Prompt Injection
ai_risks.description: Untrusted user input reaches the LLM prompt/context without sufficient trust separation, letting an attacker override system instructions, redirect tool calls, or coerce unintended model behaviour.

findings.label: Client-supplied chat messages passed to model unvalidated

ai_risks.name: Unbounded Consumption
ai_risks.description: The LLM endpoint imposes no authentication, rate, or quota boundary, so any client can drive unbounded model invocations — uncontrolled provider cost and denial of service for legitimate users.

findings.label: Unbounded chat input with no rate limit on LLM endpoint
